title: CelSector
description:
Lock disengaged. The heavy cell door opens into a chilling silence. The facility has fallen, transformed into a labyrinth where biological nightmares roam. In a world where the boundaries of flesh are violated and rewritten, the survivors must fight to stay human. Will you escape the darkness, or will your body be claimed by the aberrations prowling the halls?

High-Octane Side-Scrolling CombatNavigate a vast, interconnected research facility using an arsenal of weaponry and agile movement. Face off against over 35 unique enemy types, including infected mutants, large insects, and extraterrestrial parasites. Every encounter is brought to life with fluid, multi-stage 2D animations, highlighting the brutal struggle for survival.

Specialized ArsenalEquip yourself with 13 distinct firearms designed for containment and eradication. From tactical sidearms to heavy-yield experimental weaponry, you must choose the right caliber to neutralize the evolving biological threats and aberrations prowling the facility.

Deep Exploration & Atmospheric World-BuildingJourney through 6 meticulously hand-drawn sectors. From the claustrophobic confines of the Prison and the grime of the Sewers to the visceral interiors of Parasitic Nests and high-tech Laboratories, the world of CelSector is vast and rich with detail.

Advanced Character CustomizationFind and equip gear scattered throughout the facility to tailor your survivor’s appearance.

• 16 Independent Layers: Combine hairstyles, tops, innerwear, accessories, and much more for millions of unique looks.

• Color & Texture Control: Customize your character’s palette with 40 colors and multiple texture variations.

• Preset System: Save up to 12 custom outfits to switch between instantly during your journey.

The Biological Survival SystemCelSector features a deep "Status" system where the environment and enemies dynamically affect your character:

• Dynamic Clothing Degradation: Clothing sustains visible damage during combat. As your clothing tears, your vulnerability to environmental hazards and enemy grabs increases.

• Parasitic Infection: Certain enemies can host biological agents within the player. Strategically fight to avoid their physical mutations and debuffs.

• Tactical Status Ailments: Navigate hazards like slowing mucus, restrictive spider silk, and sensory-altering toxins that force you to adapt your strategy on the fly.

Full game is uncensored.
description_short: A 2D sci-fi action side-scroller where you fight to survive a facility overrun by biological nightmares. Blast through enemies with an arsenal of firearms, deeply customize your character's appearance, and avoid hazards, traps, and mutations.
